texts.zh:
我们在[From.Owner.Capital.GetName]上的存在引起了旁人的注意。占主要地位的文化团体现在将我们视为睿智而强大的存在，认为我们控制着元素，并最终掌握着他们的宿命。

许多人在精心设计的仪式中以自己的性命向我们宣誓效忠，担心招致我们的不悦会带来十分严重的后果。
texts.en:
Our presence on [From.Owner.Capital.GetName] has not gone unnoticed. The dominant cultural group now regards us as wise and mighty beings who control the elements and ultimately their fate.

Many have pledged their lives to us in elaborate ceremonies, fearing that incurring our displeasure could come with drastic consequences.

note.zh: 游戏里这里会出现这颗星球的名称。
note.en: In the game, the planet's name appears here.

texts.zh: 在对[FromFrom.Owner.Capital.GetName]的社会进行了大量的历史观察之后，他们占主流地位的社会群体已经把我们当作神灵来敬仰。他们希望继续用恩惠的行为得到我们的青睐……因此，为了纪念我们，血祭仍在继续。
texts.en: After actively observing their society for a substantial chunk of their history, the dominant society on [FromFrom.Owner.Capital.GetName] have come to revere us as deities. They wish to keep us in their good graces... And so the blood sacrifices continue in our honor.

note.zh: 游戏里这里会出现那颗星球的名称。
note.en: In the game, the name of that planet appears here.

texts.zh:
根据[FromFrom.Owner.Capital.GetName]当地居民的说法，根本没有神。

尽管我们试图将自己打造成他们神圣的主人，却被他们一眼看穿了本质。人们完全拒绝神灵的概念，接受了一种明显倾向于唯物主义的宇宙观。在没有确凿证据的情况下，他们相信在宇宙中只有自己。
texts.en:
According to the inhabitants of [FromFrom.Owner.Capital.GetName], there are no gods.

Although, we attempted to assert ourselves as their divine overlords, they saw through us easily. Rejecting the concept of deities altogether, the population has embraced a decidedly materialist view of the cosmos. Without hard evidence, they believe themselves alone in the universe.

texts.zh:
根据[FromFrom.Owner.Capital.GetName]当地居民的说法，根本没有神。

尽管我们试图将自己打造成他们神圣的主人，却被他们一眼看穿了本质。如果没有基于科学论证的、经同行评议的反面证据，他们已经根据经验确定，在这个现实的位面上，哪怕是遥远的神明亦不存在。他们仍有希望。
texts.en:
According to the inhabitants of [FromFrom.Owner.Capital.GetName], there are no gods.

Although, we attempted to assert ourselves as their divine overlords, they saw through us easily. Without science based, peer reviewed evidence to the contrary, they have determined empirically that nothing even remotely godly exists on this plane of reality. There is hope for them yet.

texts.zh:
根据[FromFrom.Owner.Capital.GetName]当地居民的说法，根本没有神。

尽管我们试图将自己打造成他们神圣的主人，却被他们一眼看穿了本质。这些桀骜不驯的人们拒绝向他人称臣，选择遵从自己最基础的冲动，进入无政府状态。加入机会恰当，他们应该接受我们作为他们的主人。
texts.en:
According to the inhabitants of [FromFrom.Owner.Capital.GetName], there are no gods.

Although, we attempted to assert ourselves as their divine overlords, they saw through us easily. Refusing to be subjugated, the wayward population has relented to their base urges and made the choice to become ungovernable. They should have accepted us as their masters when they had the chance.

# 我们真伟大！ / All Hail Us!

- 分类 Category：文明纪事 Society (C7) · 审阅 Reviewed 2026-10-12
- 来源 Sources：`events/first_contact_dlc_events.txt:2204-2427`；common/on_actions/00_on_actions.txt:140-201（每月观测事件池）；`events/first_contact_dlc_situation_events.txt:316-376`（preftl.50）

## 如何开始 How it starts

- 被观测的前超光速文明的“科技进步”局势每月有 5/100 的机会运行 preftl.50（之后 1800 天冷却），从每月观测事件池中按权重抽取一个条件满足的事件；本事件权重 100。
  The observed pre-FTL civilization's tech-progress situation has a 5/100 monthly chance to run preftl.50 (then an 1800-day cooldown), which draws one valid event from the monthly observation pool by weight; this event has weight 100.
- 条件：青铜或铁器时代、以“样本采集”任务观测，被观测者不是格式塔；每个前超光速文明一次。
  Conditions: Bronze or Iron Age observed with Specimen Collection, the observed civilization is not a gestalt; once per pre-FTL civilization.
- 隐藏分派事件设置一次性标记，然后在 0–25 天后向观测哨站拥有者（及游牧中继站观察者）发出可见事件。
  The hidden dispatcher sets a once-only flag and sends the visible event to the observation post owner (and nomad waystation observers) after 0-25 days.

## 剧情脉络 Story outline

- 1310「我们真伟大！」：当地主流群体把我们奉为掌控命运的神明。
  1310 "All Hail Us!": the dominant culture reveres us as mighty beings.
- “理应如此！”→ 100 天后 80% 1315「他们崇拜我们！」（血祭继续），20% 1320「诸神已逝」（他们看穿了我们）；或“他们不欠我们什么”。
  "As it should be!" → 100 days later 80% 1315 "They Worship Us!" (the sacrifices continue) or 20% 1320 "The Gods are Dead" (they saw through us); or "they owe us nothing".

## 分支与结局 Branches and outcomes

- 1315 与 1320 为互斥随机结果（80/20）。
  1315 and 1320 are exclusive random results (80/20).
- 这是随机观测插曲：只在满足条件时可能出现，彼此之间没有固定顺序。
  This is a random observation interlude: it may appear only when its conditions hold, with no fixed order relative to other interludes.

## 条件与文明差异 Conditions and variants

- 1320 按观测者的思潮有三种正文：普通、唯物、威权。
  1320 has three texts by the observer's ethics: regular, materialist, authoritarian.

## 审阅记录 Review notes

- 已核对：触发、随机权重与延迟、1320 的文本条件。
  Checked: trigger, random weights and delay, 1320 text conditions.
